networking.title: networking
networking.paragraph1: this gets its own section because it really is a big part of my life. i love meeting people: over the years a network built up around me where almost anyone is two or three handshakes away — sysadmins, developers, and people from entirely different worlds. if you need a contact or an opinion, chances are i know who to point you at.
networking.paragraph2: and the other way around: if you just want to talk infrastructure, code, photography or music — hit me up on telegram. i don't bite and i reply to almost everyone.
